name: The Architect Pack
summary:
The Architect Pack or simply T.A.P is a Don't Starve Together Mod for Base Building!
Made for people who enjoy building and feel the game has not many options for decorations. This mod contains huge amount of decorative structures for Base Building! Also this mod includes some special items, secret structures and a fellow companion!

T.A.P features structures across all the DLCs and Events of Don't Starve such as The Gorge, The Forge, Shipwrecked, Hamlet, Reign of Giants, Legacy Edition
Take a look in what you can build, the limit is your imagination!

Over +1000 Structures: Everything can be crafted in this mod!

Hidden Structures: There's also Easter Eggs, Hidden Structures, Secrets and many References in T.A.P can you find them all?
The blueprints for hidden structures can be obtained by killing specific mobs or doing specific actions!

Decorative Creatures: Some structures comes with unique mobs to make your world more alive, some mobs even interact with you. And you can find new birds across The Constant!
Packim Baggims can be obtained by killing Malbatross while Ro Bin by killing Ancient Guardian.
